parameters.name: CasterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio using the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value from the response.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, find the ID on the **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** page.

> The name of the production studio in the list is the ID.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource. To get this ID, call the [DescribeCasterChannels](~~2848046~~) operation and check the ResourceId value in the response.
